title: A section for battle backgrounds — the scenes you can pick in Hero View
note: Asked for through the contact form. It lives in the live viewer rather than a tab of its own: pick any battle background to sit behind a unit from the Hero View Background Pack list, and the Vertical View toggle shows it in the game's portrait frame.
